failure_summary.description: Agents omitted or mis-mapped accumulated criteria, including cuisine, exact ratings, location fields, or supported flight-class values.
Agents failed to update suitable cached results for new constraints or saved a base result instead of the filtered result.
Searches or itinerary legs were left unsaved, or the saved object was not the exact result produced by the operation.
Agents added unnecessary searches or proximity operations beyond the requested deliverables.
An explicit travel date range was treated as an arrival-date constraint instead of separate outbound and return legs.

patch.reasoning: The observed failures are already addressed by explicit skill rules for preserving conversation criteria, updating cached results, saving exact tool outputs, avoiding unrequested operations, and handling round trips. These recurring errors indicate non-adherence rather than a distinct uncovered gap, so adding more guidance would duplicate existing content.
